sloka: तां प्रविश्य महामायां प्राप्तां गोपतिना पुरा ।प्रविवेश सुसंरब्धस्तत्सैन्यं समभिद्रवत् ।। ७.२९.२३ ॥
transliteration: tāṁ praviśya mahāmāyāṁ prāptāṁ gopatinā purā ।praviveśa susaṁrabdhastatsainyaṁ samabhidravat ।। 7.29.23 ॥

translations.english: Having entered that great illusion, which was formerly obtained by Indra, Indrajit, greatly agitated, entered and attacked that army.
